effect_description_eng:
＜Decoy ([Bagra Army] trait)＞ (When your other [Bagra Army] trait Digimon would be deleted by an opponent's effect, you may delete this Digimon to prevent 1 of those Digimon's deletion.)
[All Turns] All of your [Yuu Amano] can't be deleted.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [Damemon] from your trash suspended without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] When an effect trashes this card from digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
